assign.request: Refine the research system by wiring it to a live program: build /imagine/research/ as the front over four topic logs (findings stream, topic cards, theories board, credence legend), refine ext/Research against this real use, and judge whether research becomes a .claude/skills/research/ trigger skill.
steps: Read the system — ext/Research, ext/JSONL live, the topic contract
Aggregate reader over the four topic logs
The front: stream, topic cards, theories board, credence legend
Verify headless: synthetic log, 400/1920, counts agree
Skill verdict — write it or say why not

assign.now: verified — writing the docs and the skill verdict

log.msg: Front renders live against the real logs: 175 entries, and wc -l over the four log.jsonl files is 175 — the two numbers agree. 0 off-schema, 0 unreadable: every line the four minions have written passes the new schema.
Live append proven headless: a line written by entry.mjs while the tab was open took the page 19 -> 20 entries with no reload, console clean.

Two silent traps cost time and are now commented in Program.js: a Page subclass method named card() is handed to .ac() by Page.nav() and kills the PARENT card wall; a method named topics() is overwritten by the topics: config field.

assign.outcome:
**The research program has a front, and the research system has a second shape.** [/imagine/research/](/imagine/research/) reads all four minions log.jsonl files live — 180 entries at landing, streaming in with no reload — and renders the credence legend, a card per topic, the theories board and the newest of the stream.

![the front](front.png)

**The epistemic backbone holds.** established / contested / fringe / speculation each carry the difference THREE ways at once — hue, border texture (solid dashed dotted double, so it survives greyscale) and the printed word with its promise as a tooltip. Speculation is the one that also changes the type to italic. The page never upgrades a credence, never ranks, and never hides an off-schema line: it shows it with the reason, so entries + unreadable = the files line count. Verified — wc -l said 175, the page said 175.

**ext/Research gained the program shape, not a second module.** [`entries.js`](/framework/ext/Research/doc/file/entries.js/) is the flat entry schema beside `verbs.js`; [`entry.mjs`](/framework/ext/Research/doc/file/entry.mjs/) is the validated writer (refuses with a reason, exit 1, blocks a path outside public/, and `--check` validates a whole log with line numbers); `Program.js` is the reader + front. The rounds DID map — a scouts claim is an entry, the skeptics mainstream-check is an opinion, and the verdict is the credence carried on every line instead of assigned once at the end. [`doc/program.md`](/framework/ext/Research/doc/program/) · [`doc/decisions.md`](/framework/ext/Research/doc/decisions/)

**The skill verdict: yes.** [`.claude/skills/research/`](/framework/ai/2026-08-30/research-system/) — the credence discipline is the one thing an agent gets wrong (everything reads established), it lived only in a mastermind prompt, and a skill fires at the moment the agent needs it rather than when it happens to open the module.

**Deliberately left:** the topic shapes ranking machinery (outline, importance votes, parked) — all of it exists to decide what to dig next, and a continuous program answers that with keep digging. No `parent` on an entry, so the board groups assessments by topic and says on the page that it cannot pair one to a claim. No MCP tools for `entry` (needs a server restart; the CLI carried the run). No page of my own under the topic dirs — those are the minions.
